bullets.text: Securing AI Supply Chains - **Microsoft** emphasizes the importance of securing AI application supply chains against vulnerabilities like CVE-2025-68664.
AI-Driven Threat Detection - **Microsoft** introduces an AI-assisted workflow to streamline detection analysis from unstructured threat reports.
Data Security Index Insights - The 2026 **Microsoft** Data Security Index highlights the need for unified data security in AI adoption.
Celebrating Security Excellence - **Microsoft** honors the 2026 Security Excellence Awards winners for their contributions to cybersecurity.
AI Inference Breakthrough - **Microsoft** unveils Maia 200, an AI accelerator designed to enhance inference performance and efficiency.
Government Data Security Strategies - **Microsoft** outlines proactive measures for safeguarding governmental data against sophisticated cyber threats.
